headline: 8 of 8 in 34:56, the guild's second fastest BWL, without a single wipe

mvp.headline: 97 average parse, 99 on four bosses, no deaths
why: 99 on Firemaw, Ebonroc, Chromaggus and Nefarian, 98 on Flamegor and never below 90
Never died, and handed out 3 Innervates

also.text: top damage of the raid on Razorgore, Ebonroc, Chromaggus and Nefarian
top healer on five of the eight bosses
16 Brood Afflictions cleansed on Chromaggus, the most in the raid

overview: A full clear in 34:56, eight kills from eight pulls, second only to the 33:23 on 11 September and almost ten minutes under the guild's usual BWL (44:26). Every boss died at or under the guild's median kill time, Firemaw two seconds off the record.
Six deaths all night, two of them on trash. The parse medians tell the same story as the clock: 91 on Firemaw against a usual 85, 84 on Chromaggus against 75, 80 on Vaelastrasz against 67.

wentWell.text: Firemaw in 0:45 against a guild median of 1:28 and a record of 0:43, so Flame Buffet only stacked to 6 per raider instead of the usual 11. Median parse 91; Skoomael, Osinir and Drikkle 99.
Chromaggus in 1:20 (median 1:44), breaths hitting half as often as usual, 65 Brood Afflictions cleansed (Allipalli 16, Pinkcheese 10) and 6 Tranquilizing Shots.
Nefarian in 1:54 (median 2:06). Only 8 people feared all fight against the usual 40 or so, with 7 Fear Wards out.
Vaelastrasz in 0:30 against a median of 0:40, with a median parse of 80 against the usual 67.

notes.text: 0:27 once Razorgore himself was up, a second under the median, no deaths. Drikkle parsed 96.
0:30 against a median of 0:40 on 33k raid DPS (usually 25k). Skoomael 97, Miniwrecker 92, Eduard 91.
Two deaths: Flame Breath killed a mage at 0:17, and his melee killed a DPS warrior at 0:28, two seconds before the kill. Boss melee did 47k, about four times its usual share of the damage.
0:48, right on the median, no deaths. Blast Wave hit 20 raiders, 0.5 per raider against the usual 0.9.
0:45, two seconds off the guild record and 43 seconds under the median, with no deaths and 22k raid DPS against a usual 12k. Shadow Flame touched one raider twice.
1:04, just under the median 1:07, no deaths. Skoomael 99, Drikkle 97, Tochopolvo 96.

Shadow of Ebonroc landed 7 times, the usual rate. The log shows him healing 25,000 per hit on a tank with it, 363k in all; older logs don't record those heals, so there's no guild average to compare it with.
0:53 against a median of 1:00, no deaths. 5 Tranquilizing Shots from three hunters, Grenan 2, and Fire Nova hit 4 times per raider against a usual 5.4.
1:20 against a median of 1:44 with no deaths. Breaths hit 5 raiders 18 times, half the usual rate, and 65 afflictions were cleansed.
The breaths that did land were Ignite Flesh (11k) and Frost Burn (5k).
1:54 against a median of 2:06 on 21k raid DPS. Shadow Flame hit 27 raiders about once each, as usual.
Two late deaths to Bone Constructs, the skeletons of the last phase, at 1:37 and 1:52, both mages.
